 Follow K-Pop Concert Film ‘Twice: This Is For… You’ Acquired by Bleecker Street’s Crosswalk and Universal Pictures International
 Mya Copeland Mon, November 9, 2026 at 1:00 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. K-Pop Concert Film ‘Twice: This Is For… You’ Acquired by Bleecker Street’s Crosswalk and Universal Pictures International Bleecker Street's event cinema division Crosswalk and Universal Pictures Content Group have acquired North American and international rights, respectively, to "Twice: This Is For… You."
 The film captures K-pop phenomenon Twice at London's O2 Arena during their "This Is For" world tour. It features concert footage and exclusive behind-the-scenes access to the group.

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "Twice are a truly global phenomenon, and 'This Is For… You' 'captures everything that makes their live performances so special," said Helen Parker, executive vice president of Universal Pictures Content Group.
 This release builds on the success of "Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience" concert film featuring the global K-pop group Stray Kids, which Crosswalk and Universal Pictures Content Group distributed earlier this year. Paul Dugdale, who directed the film, directed "Twice: This Is For… You."
 "Following the incredible response to 'Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience,' we're delighted to continue our partnership with Crosswalk and Live Nation to bring another world-class K-pop experience to cinemas and give fans around the world the opportunity to experience it together on the big screen," Parker added.
 Dugdale ("Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience," "Adele: One Night Only," "Taylor Swift: Reputation Stadium Tour") and Hannah Lux Davis (ADELA's "Nicole Kidman" and Ariana Grande's "thank you, next") directed the film. The film is produced by Live Nation Studios. Crosswalk will release the film in the U.S. and Canada, and Universal Pictures International across international territories.
 Advertisement Advertisement Twice is a nine-member K-pop group consisting of Nayeon, Jeongyeon, Momo, Sana, Jihyo, Mina, Dahyun, Chaeyoung and Tzuyu. The group formed under JYP Entertainment in 2015 and is one of the best-selling K-pop recording artists of all time, with a No. 1 hit on the Billboard 200, seven consecutive top 10 entries on the chart and two Gold and one Platinum certification from the RIAA.
 "Twice: This Is For… You" is set for theatrical release on Feb. 5, 2027.
